description:
Rename an AI Tracker (Brand Radar) prompt topic. topicId is the topic UUID (from list_prompt_topics); title is the new title, which must be non-empty and unique within the property (renaming a topic to its own current title is a no-op success). Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// rename a prompt topic
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","topicId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001","title":"Pricing & plans"}
```
name: update_prompt_topic
title: Rename prompt topic
